name: Do you offer warranties or guarantees on your exterior painting services?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer warranties or guarantees on your exterior painting services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we stand behind the quality of our workmanship. We typically offer a warranty on our exterior painting services, covering aspects like peeling, blistering, or chipping caused by improper application. The specific terms and duration of the warranty will be outlined in your project proposal. We use high-quality materials and experienced painters to ensure a long-lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we offer warranties on our exterior painting services covering issues from improper application. Details are in the project proposal.
